bullets.id: Emas spot anjlok 2,8% pada Kamis dan ditutup di $3.876, penutupan terendah dalam lebih dari setahun, setelah sempat menyentuh $3.852. Klaim pengangguran mingguan naik ke 200.000, di atas perkiraan 195.000, tetapi tidak cukup meredam taruhan kenaikan bunga Fed. Pagi ini emas memantul ke sekitar $3.910, naik 0,87% menurut Trading Economics, namun tetap menuju kerugian mingguan yang tajam.
bullets.en: Spot gold slumped 2.8% on Thursday to close at $3,876, its lowest close in more than a year, after touching $3,852. Weekly jobless claims rose to 200,000, above the 195,000 forecast, but that was not enough to cool Fed hike bets. This morning gold bounced to about $3,910, up 0.87% according to Trading Economics, yet it is still headed for a sharp weekly loss.

bullets.id: Indeks dolar mencapai 103,21, tertinggi 19 bulan, dan yield Treasury 10 tahun di sekitar 5,10%. Trading Economics mencatat pasar memberi peluang sekitar 85% untuk kenaikan 25 bps pada Desember dan 15% untuk 50 bps, sementara harga minyak ikut naik setelah Trump menyebut AS tidak lagi membutuhkan kesepakatan dengan Iran. Emas kini turun sekitar 4,8% dalam sebulan dan sekitar 30% di bawah rekor $5.608,35.
bullets.en: The dollar index reached 103.21, a 19-month high, and the 10-year Treasury yield sits near 5.10%. Trading Economics says markets price about an 85% chance of a 25 bp hike in December and 15% for 50 bp, while oil rose after Trump said the US no longer needed a deal with Iran. Gold is now down about 4.8% on the month and about 30% below its $5,608.35 record.

bullets.id: Level terdekat adalah titik terendah Kamis di $3.852 dan level $3.850 yang disorot Goldman Sachs. Di atas, $3.944 dan $4.000 menjadi resistance. Malam ini pasar menunggu PPI Oktober, data inflasi produsen yang bisa memperkuat atau meredam taruhan kenaikan bunga, lalu keputusan Fed pada 9 Desember.
bullets.en: The nearest levels are Thursday’s $3,852 low and the $3,850 level flagged by Goldman Sachs. Above, $3,944 and $4,000 act as resistance. Tonight markets await October PPI, producer inflation data that could strengthen or soften hike bets, followed by the Fed decision on 9 December.

bullets.id: Antam 1 gram turun Rp9.000 ke Rp2.509.000 dan buyback turun Rp31.000 ke Rp2.285.000, sehingga spread melebar ke Rp224.000 (sekitar 8,9%). Galeri24 turun Rp13.000 ke Rp2.483.000 (buyback Rp2.337.000, spread sekitar 5,9%) dan UBS turun Rp12.000 ke Rp2.508.000 (buyback Rp2.312.000, spread sekitar 7,8%). Secara struktural, bank sentral membeli 321 ton pada kuartal III, naik 42% secara tahunan, dan PBoC menambah 25,8 ton pada Oktober.
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price fell Rp9,000 to Rp2,509,000 and buyback fell Rp31,000 to Rp2,285,000, widening the spread to Rp224,000 (about 8.9%). Galeri24 fell Rp13,000 to Rp2,483,000 (buyback Rp2,337,000, spread about 5.9%) and UBS fell Rp12,000 to Rp2,508,000 (buyback Rp2,312,000, spread about 7.8%). Structurally, central banks bought 321 tonnes in Q3, up 42% year on year, and the PBoC added 25.8 tonnes in October.
